'''Tradu Vola''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She would trade gold certificates for prizes at [[Club Vertica Casino|Club Vertica]] during [[Soovada]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />
